This behavioral check exercises repeated seeded resets, independently recomputes compiled-limit IK legality, verifies focused negative-bearing folded-only targets across the full radius range, confirms the uniform component remains present, and checks that official evaluation remains full-radius and unchanged.

request.description: Train one branch-and-geometry-focused candidate from T3:checkpoint-110592 using the verified 50/50 full-radius uniform and folded-only negative-bearing reset route.
request.rationale: I3 targets T3's seven folded_only failures, including five never-reached and two 1-3-step holds at negative bearings across the radius range. M19-M20 verify that the changed production training environment realizes the intended focused exposure without altering official evaluation mechanics. A full maintainer-allocation transfer from the measured T3 checkpoint tests whether this route can improve complete uninterrupted official-geometry success; learning proxies and terminal checkpoints will only nominate artifacts for measurement, not establish performance.

request.description: Evaluate T4:checkpoint-5120 from the branch-and-geometry-focused route against frozen T3:checkpoint-110592 on the independent same-seed official-geometry development panel, retaining complete-hold and branch/geometry/control diagnostics.
request.rationale: T4's altered training exposure makes its proxy incomparable to T3's training proxy, and the terminal checkpoint is not privileged. T4:checkpoint-5120 is the highest-ranked recorded T4 proxy checkpoint (0.833) and is therefore the route artifact nominated for direct development measurement. The paired frozen-T3 comparison is the required candidate-level test of whether the route reduces T3's folded-only negative-bearing residual without spending the protected assessment. Official success remains the uninterrupted 100-step hold.

pi_checkpoint.candidates_and_roles: T3:checkpoint-110592 remains best-known by E9, supported by T3 and M18. T2:checkpoint-120832 remains the reference candidate. No working or retained role is assigned. Neither T3's best-known role nor its 153/160 development result certifies the human goal.
pi_checkpoint.cumulative_resource_use: Before I3: three training runs (T1-T3), sixteen completed measurements, two completed inquiries, six completed sessions in the durable record, no protected 200-episode assessment, and T3 assigned best-known. The current goal-review session completed E12, opening the third inquiry; no training or measurement allocation has been spent in I3.
pi_checkpoint.current_goal_gap: T3 achieved 153/160 successes (95.625%) on the independent 160-episode official-geometry development panel, leaving seven failures versus the 98% objective. All seven failed episodes were classified folded_only; five never reached tolerance and two reached tolerance for only 1-3 held steps. The failed radii span approximately 10.7-18.8 cm and therefore do not establish an inner-radius-only deficit. The official 200-episode assessment has not been spent.
pi_checkpoint.current_synthesis: Established observations: M16 and M17 verified production compatibility and controlled behavior of the tested velocity-aware near-target reward route. T3 was a 120,000-step transfer from T2 with changed scientific source, no exact saved-component matches, and a learning proxy that peaked at 0.93 at 105472 and 110592 steps before falling to 0.90 at the terminal checkpoint; M18 therefore measured 110592, not the terminal checkpoint. M18 independently compared complete artifacts on identical official-geometry seeds: T3 won all three discordant episodes, improved 150/160 to 153/160, reduced never-reached failures from 7 to 5 and reached-but-incomplete failures from 3 to 2, and reduced hold interruptions. T3 is consequently best-known by E9, but this is candidate-selection evidence for the complete artifact, not causal evidence that the velocity penalty alone produced the gain. Correction to the inherited interpretation: the residual failures are not only an unresolved generic stabilization problem. M18's episode-level diagnostics show all seven T3 failures are folded_only, with five never reaching and two reaching only 1-3 held steps, and their bearings cluster on the negative side while radii span the distribution. This supports a branch/geometry-specific investigation as a consequential next direction, but does not establish branch causality, a policy asymmetry mechanism, or a coverage-versus-control explanation. The physical model still predicts that legal IK branch choice, configuration-dependent Jacobian and bounded 20 ms actuation can alter reachability and braking; endpoint diagnostics do not measure excursions during the ten internal MuJoCo steps, so within-frame behavior remains unresolved. Competing explanations for the residual are folded-branch representation/coverage, bearing-dependent reach/control authority or saturation, and sampled-hold instability after reaching; branch- and geometry-aligned trajectories and complete candidate comparison can discriminate their practical consequence. Official success remains the authoritative uninterrupted sampled hold, not reward, minimum distance, or a proxy.
pi_checkpoint.decision_frontier: The immediate assessment-versus-inquiry decision has been revised in favor of one bounded inquiry because M18 supplies an observed residual pattern, not merely an untested hypothesis: all seven T3 failures are folded_only, with five never-reached and two reached-but-incomplete. The consequential distinction is whether a branch- and geometry-focused route can reduce these failures enough to make assessment more credible, versus whether the pattern persists and points to general control or sampled-hold limitations. Evidence that would discriminate is one route comparison against frozen T3 on an independent official-geometry panel, retaining complete success, target radius and bearing, IK branch legality/classification, first reach, maximum hold, interruptions, velocity, and saturation; substep traces remain a useful but not yet available discriminator for hidden within-frame excursions. The development panel must remain separate from the protected assessment.
pi_checkpoint.human_goal_connection: The sole human objective is at least 196 complete uninterrupted 100-step holds in the protected 200-episode official assessment. T3:checkpoint-110592 is the best-known artifact at 153/160 on a separate development panel, so the goal remains unmet and the protected assessment remains unspent. I3 is opened because the remaining failures show a consequential, testable folded-branch and bearing structure that may be more valuable to address before terminal assessment.
pi_checkpoint.next_direction_or_closure: Open I3 for one bounded branch- and geometry-focused candidate route. The inquiry is goal-linked to the seven observed T3 failures and is preferable to immediate terminal assessment because it can test an actionable, failure-aligned route while preserving the protected panel. I3 will close after one complete candidate route is evaluated against frozen T3 with the stated diagnostics: positive if it reaches at least 157/160 with reduced folded-only failures, limited if it improves but remains below that development equivalent, and negative if it does not reduce the residual gap. Any outcome returns to goal review; no development result is substituted for the official assessment.
